matches.notes: The studio intro runs on from the show's opening titles montage (00:58-01:35) and the welcome to the pundits; the match-specific set-up begins at 01:54 ("Spurs had a point to prove..."). The pitchside interviews with both managers/players (from 11:07) are included in the highlights; studio analysis begins mid-line at 12:26 when the pundit picks up on the Newcastle manager's quote.
matches.handover: Steve Wilson was at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

matches.notes: The studio analysis runs on from tactical discussion of Forest's shape and Isak's touch map into a brief Gakpo transfer aside and then a replay-led explanation of the broken substitution board that Iraola complained about in his interview — the latter is still discussion of this match, so it is kept inside the analysis segment, which ends when the Coventry v Hull introduction begins at 32:52.

matches.handover: Guy Mowbray was at the CBS Arena.

matches.notes: There is no named-commentator credit for this match; the studio hands over with the Bournemouth-v-Everton head-to-head line at 43:32 and commentary begins at 43:44. The pitchside interviews with Moyes and Rose (51:20-52:41) are counted with the highlights; the studio-introduced post-match press-conference clip about transfers (52:41-53:08) is treated as the opening of the studio analysis, which then runs through the Alex Scott and set-piece breakdowns until the Sunday MOTD trail at 57:04.
matches.handover: Bournemouth had more wins against Everton than any other team they've faced in the Premier League, nine in total, two of which came when Ashley was at Everton.

matches.notes: Match played the previous day (28 Aug); shown last in the episode as a held-over full package introduced with "Time for last night's action". Post-match manager interviews (66:29–67:08) are included in the highlights segment; studio analysis of Cherki runs to 69:02, where the programme moves on to the league table.
matches.handover: Mark Scott was at Selhurst Park.
